causal_scope: observable model behavior unless separate identification assumptions are supplied
required_design: freeze cohort split before model fitting
keep repeated biological units in one partition
use matched inputs, concepts, outcomes, folds, and selection budgets
export combined and identifiable route-only predictions
fit leakage decoders out of sample
required_metrics: combined diagnosis AUROC, AUPRC, and Brier score
concept-route and residual-route diagnosis where identifiable
semantic concept recovery where labels exist
route reliance with explicit gauge qualification
model-level concept replacement response where supported
replication_unit_rule: Report uncertainty at the independent biological or training-seed level; folds are blocks, not independent replicates.
